changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Override') BEGIN create table security.[Override] ( Id uniqueidentifier constraint DF_Security_Override_Id default(newsequentialid()) not null, RoleId int not null, SecurityType int not null, SecurityId int not null, AssetId bigint not null, Context nvarchar(max) sparse, CreatedBy int not null, CreatedOn datetime not null, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, constraint PK_Security_Override primary key clustered ( Id ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Override_Asset') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Override_Asset] ON [security].[Override] ( AssetId asc ) include (SecurityType, SecurityId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Override_SecurityType') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Override_SecurityType] ON [security].[Override] ( SecurityType asc, SecurityId asc ) include (AssetId) END
